notes.title: Update V1.02
notes.notes:
Added new graphics for the Steel Town factory.
 Added sound FX for sliding Metal door.
 Added help guide to get through a cracked wall.
 Added random heart after destroying an enemy.
 Added Loading… screen.
 Fixed ‘zooming not available’ in certain circumstances.

notes.title: Patch V1.01
notes.notes:
Added 1 new Big Cave!
Added arrow keys to Player movement.
Changed the Grab beside Pete button from “Right Shift” to “ /  ? “ button on keyboard. It is still A (south) button on controller. Going to eventually use the Shift buttons on the keyboard for running.
Paused Game with Steam Overlay up.
Added Delete Saved game option in the Main Menu.
Fixed overlapping menus and dialog.
